scope: Round 10. User request (2026-10-27): 'update the theme to dark color'. The whole app switches to a dark palette built from the round 8 tokens (docs/design-system.md). Builds on round 9 (archived as progress-feature-list/feature_list_9.json). No behaviour, layout or text changes; every business rule from rounds 1-9 stays.

source_requirements.text: update the theme to dark color

readings_to_confirm: 'Update the theme to dark' = the app is dark for everyone, replacing the light palette. No light/dark toggle and no following the OS setting (can be added later as its own feature).

The brand hues stay (navy, crimson, steel, cream): navy remains the fill for primary buttons, active tabs and the dashboard credit card; crimson and cream stay the outbid / warning accents, lightened where they are used as text so they stay readable on dark surfaces.

conventions.tests: Playwright e2e specs go in e2e/ as <id>-<slug>.spec.ts. fe vitest has no DOM, so colour checks run in e2e against computed styles.
conventions.existing_tests: No existing spec checks colours; all must keep passing unchanged.
conventions.change_docs: docs/changes/<id>.md lists changed files; docs/design-system.md token table updated to the dark values.
conventions.accessibility: Text meets WCAG AA (4.5:1, 3:1 for 24px+ / 19px bold) on its own background; native controls follow the dark scheme (color-scheme: dark).
conventions.run_all: ./init.sh must exit 0 before the feature moves to passing.

status_legend.in_progress: The feature is the current active task.
status_legend.blocked: Work cannot continue until a documented blocker is resolved.
status_legend.passing: Required verification has passed and evidence is recorded.

features.title: Dark colour theme across the app
features.user_visible_behavior: Every page (top bar, homepage, lot page, dashboard, bid history, credit, staff and admin pages, dialogs, toasts, charts) uses a dark background with light text. Brand navy, steel, crimson and cream stay recognisable as accents. Form fields, selects and date pickers are dark too.
acceptance: Page background, cards, tables, inputs and menus are dark; body text is light.
No hard-coded light background (#fff, light tints) is left in fe/src/styles.css outside tokens; badge / notice / banner tints come from dark tint tokens.
Text colour roles split from fill roles: text uses --ink / --muted / --link, fills use --navy / --primary, so no dark-on-dark text.
color-scheme: dark is set so native controls and scrollbars follow.
WCAG AA contrast for body text, muted text, links, card titles, prices, pills, badges, bid strips, primary / steel / custom-bid buttons, active chip.
Charts keep readable grid, axis and tick colours on the dark surface.
verification: e2e/theme-1-1-dark.spec.ts: on the homepage (guest + customer), a lot page and the dashboard, body background is dark (luminance < 0.05), and an in-page contrast audit over visible text elements finds none under AA against their effective background
All existing vitest and Playwright specs pass unchanged
Screenshot review of homepage, lot page, dashboard, credit page
features.notes: fe has no colours in TSX (all in fe/src/styles.css), so the change is CSS only.
